entities.name: Noor Mohammad Saqib
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Noor Mohammad Saqib is the Minister of Hajj and Awqaf in the Taliban rule in Afghanistan. He has also previously been the chief justice of the Supreme Court during the 1996–2001 Taliban rule of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.
